stages.label: Routes evaluated
stages.narrative: Fastest and shade-selected routes are sampled at their modeled arrival times.

stages.label: Walker departs
stages.narrative: The walker advances through direct sun, building shade, canopy attenuation, and unknown exposure.

stages.label: Exposure accumulates
stages.narrative: Each timestamped sample changes the visible route position and accumulated exposure totals.

stages.label: Walk settles
stages.narrative: Travel time and clear-sky exposure settle against the fastest-route baseline.
